chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Pulpits will be placed on the Day of Resurrection around the Throne for my Shias and the Shias of my Household who are sincere in our Wilayah. And Allah, the Exalted and Mighty, will say: 'Come, O My servants, to Me, so that I may bestow upon you My Nobility, for you were harmed in the world.'

key_terms.مَنَابِرُ: Pulpits or elevated seats of honor

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for the sincere Shia on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith highlights the concept of *al-Wilayah* as the defining criterion for the 'sincere' (*al-Mukhlasan*) Shi'a, linking their earthly tribulations directly to their eschatological elevation. The placement of pulpits around the Throne signifies a unique proximity to God, serving as a divine compensation for the persecution suffered by the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers throughout history.
